newsitem.title: USA: Exxon gets UK approval for gas field probe.
newsitem.headline: Exxon gets UK approval for gas field probe.

text.p: Exxon Corp said Thursday the British Department of Trade and Industry had approved the second phase of development of the Galleon natural gas field, located in the UK southern North Sea.
Esso Exploration and Production UK Ltd, Exxon's British upstream affiliate, holds a 40 percent initial interest in the Galleon Field, the company said.

The second phase of the Galleon development will cost about $240 million and will develop some 770 GCF of natural gas in the northwest sector of the field. A new wellhead platform and 11 development wells will be installed, Exxon said.
Production is expected to begin in the fourth quarter of 1998 and reach a plateau of 90,000 cubic feet per day, Exxon said.
